items.title: Build compact Journey and Permanent Achievements Journal using real LOREBOUND data
items.quote: "I want to design this journey page to be like this. I don't want to have all the dividers for type. I just want the journey or whatever it's called then the permanent achievements. The permanent achievements need to be less in count but more in its levels and rewards. But right now the look needs to be achieved first."  "Yes but it needs to use our info ... tell Claude how to code what I want, then we can provide the achievement list."

asks.text: Should the Journal always open on Journey, or on whichever tab you used last? My suggestion: keep it on the last tab you used, as it is now. A red diamond on the other tab still shows when something there is ready.

Under "The First Chronicle" the summary now says "Your Journey", or "Your Achievements" on the other tab, like in your mockup. My suggestion: keep these words. Or tell me what you'd like it to say instead.

Your mockup shows claimed quests with green checks in the main list. The Journal moves them into a closed "Completed" section at the bottom, as your request asked. My suggestion: keep the Completed section, so the list shows only what's left. Or should claimed quests stay in…

items.title: Improve Adventure battlefield layout with shared nameplate and party frame
items.quote: Reviewed screenshots of LOREBOUND Adventure at Floor 90 with the party both collapsed and expanded. "Can you review this front page and compile recommended assets that could improve the layout?" Then, for two recommended reusable assets (combat nameplate and party/dock panel): "Lead the way and make it happen."

asks.text: Merging this puts two new pictures, which Joshua hasn't approved yet, into the real game (they're in his Proposed folder). My suggestion: merge only after Joshua says yes on the test site.
Do you want to keep the new frame around the enemy's name? My suggestion: yes, the name and health bar are easier to read now.

Do you want to keep the new party tray frame? With it, the closed tray shows the frame's corners and the background's own curls together. My suggestion: keep it, but only if the two sets of ornaments don't bother you. If they do, I can go back to the old tray edge.

asks.text: Nothing new. Merging this puts the moved button in the real game, so it waits for your OK as usual.

asks.text: Joshua said yes, for now, to the Town Locations menu in #67: one small Locations menu in the corner instead of the five big building buttons. It moves the camera to the building and shows Locked / Ready to restore / Restored. Dragging, keyboard and tapping buildings all stay.…

items.quote: yeah get them in i approve all

#71 asks the same "Recruits" question. Suggestion: merge this pull request (or move its one-line change into #71), then post a new report on #71 with that question marked answered.

items.title: Animated compact Summoning Rift — replace rail Tome after color/art approval
items.quote: "also to replace the tome i want to do the below  A compact Summoning Rift—an ancient carved-stone focus containing luminous violet energy. Companions emerge from it. same size as the current tome roughly. also i wnat to have it be a gif if possible, not sure if it is"  "Presentation requirements: - It replaces the existing purple Tome in the lower Adventure summoning rail. - Keep it compact and visually prominent. - Preserve space for the battlefield, five-companion Party dock and bottom navigation. - Keep Summon, Auto and access to summoning upgrades/options clear. - It must work whether the Party dock is expanded or collapsed. - Do not turn it into an enormous portal that occupies the battlefield. - Avoid generic rectangular website buttons or excessive ornament."  "yeah lets do that. although im not sold on the puirple color"

asks.text: The Rift is a still picture for now. To make the swirl actually turn inside the stone, ChatGPT needs to make separate pictures: (a) the stone and bronze frame with an empty middle, (b) the teal swirl by itself, and (c) if you want, a few small sparks. Each should be a PNG…
Do you want the Rift to glow a little brighter for a moment after each summon? My suggestion: yes, a short soft teal flash. I can add it to this still picture now, without new art.

Your mine painting already has the refinery, reservoir and carts painted in, and the station pictures each bring their own stone platform. Putting them together would show doubled machines. For now the mine uses the painting alone, and the stations get a soft glow as they…

Extraction Pit and Transport show only their names for now, with no "coming soon" text. Should they say anything else? I suggest leaving them as names until their upgrades are designed.

Do you approve the teal Rift picture in the Proposed folder (LOREBOUND_Summoning_Rift_SeaGlassTeal_Static_v01_PROPOSED.png) as the final look? Suggestion: if you like it at small size, say yes and ask ChatGPT to move it to the Approved folder with its manifest.

items.title: Build reusable LOREBOUND UI kit from individually supplied artwork
items.quote: "We just need to start thinking about how to make general assets instead of super specific stuff. It's not very scalable with the stage of development we are at. It's exhausting constantly rendering and sending only for a lot to still not look right."  Joshua approved the LOREBOUND shared UI kit concept board, asked how to make the assets available to the builders, and emphasized: "Claude doesn't do image generation."

items.title: Build explorable vertical Town from approved Mossbound Ruins terrain
items.quote: "I think we need to render a new draggable background so it looks legit. Also I want to suggest orienting the area to be more vertical as well as more space between them so it feels like a real town. Maybe have different decor and stuff to make it feel real."  Joshua confirmed that the Town should be a living village gradually restored over time, and **approved the final terrain-only vertical illustration** on October 28, 2026.

items.title: Intro-style companion pages with shared type habitats and size/weight
items.quote: I want you to ask to have all the companion pages look like the first intro egg pages, and if there isn’t a background for it let me know. It should just be one per type not one per each companion. Also drop the one line sentences and just put weights and sizes like in pokemon, it can generate them based on the name.

items.title: Keep automatic combat running behind menus and other tabs
items.quote: Before that I want the auto battler to continue no matter what menu or anything is present.

items.title: Party reordering, continuous Auto Summon and in-dock companion decisions
items.quote: You should be able to hold or long press and drag a character or companion if you have the non-collapsed menu ... drag and re-order them and it changed the position on the map and re-orient them. You should also only be asked to release a companion if you don’t choose auto. Auto should move to a single button ... a menu that shows the current odds in a clean table ... Which rarity should you stop at? ... Start auto summoning. It auto summons until you run out of shards ... if you have the three option unlocked ... open three books ... in the same time you would open up one. If you have auto summon running, it should shake like normal and then pop little sprites ... half the size of the little tome at the bottom ... then fade away for the one behind it ... open 20 at a time ... quickly flash one at a time ... in that tiny view. It only pops up with the full character if you have not discovered it yet, or if it is a rarity that you have selected that you wanted to stop at regardless of whether you have already opened it or not.
